title: Zesty Roasted Jamaican Yam Roast
description: A tender, comforting Jamaican dish featuring roasted white yam, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Peel the yams and cut them into 1-inch chunks.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, allspice, thyme, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the yam chunks to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Transfer the yams to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and arrange them in a single layer.
Roast the yams in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, remove the yams from the oven and brush them with the lime juice and grated ginger.
Return the yams to the oven and roast for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until they are tender and caramelized.
Remove the yams from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
